title: Range Slice C honest native track accent
purpose: Resolve the range audit's selected-track honesty issue without overextending into a custom range engine.
objective: Make the Elementor control language, selectors, and CSS variables match the native range implementation's actual behavior.
scope_boundary: In scope: control label/description, selector cleanup, CSS variable naming compatibility, documentation, and verification. Out of scope: custom selected interval overlay, dual-range engine rewrite, browser screenshot QA, and broader range craft controls.
entry_condition: TASK-FC-019 is done and the plugin worktree is clean.
exit_condition: The range color control no longer claims a true selected interval track and no longer leaks into rating color.
completion_criteria: The user-facing label is honest about native range accent behavior.
The existing range color setting remains backward compatible.
Rating color remains owned by its dedicated rating control.
The real selected interval fill remains documented as a future custom-track slice.

phases.title: Control contract
phases.purpose: Rename and describe the range track color control accurately.

phases.title: Selector isolation
phases.purpose: Remove unrelated rating selectors from range-owned controls.

phases.title: Verification
phases.purpose: Run syntax/diff checks and record the deferred true-fill boundary.

acceptance_criteria: No plugin source outside range style controls and range CSS is changed unless verification proves it necessary.
Guilherme visual QA remains required for final craft approval.
verification: Plugin PHP lint, Composer validation, JS syntax check, and diff checks pass.
stop_conditions: The slice starts implementing a custom dual-range engine.
The change silently breaks existing saved range color settings.
